story.title: A journey from magical nature
story.text1: Our vocalist Sol wrote this song inspired by the long journeys people from rural areas full of magical nature take to the city in search of opportunities.
story.text2: She created the first guitar demo, and the rest of the band built our parts together. We recorded it at Delirium Studio in a fun, collaborative process.
story.text3: We're celebrating the release on Instagram and TikTok with the cover art, a cinematic short film, and a sign language lyric video to make it more accessible.
